headline: Gannon become first side to score twice against Frostburg State
dek: Sunday's defeat at Gannon was Frostburg State's first since Point Park in September, and their third in a season of 17 wins and three draws. They have conceded nine goals in all while scoring more than any other programme in the conference.
displaced_by: Gannon's win over Frostburg State took their goals conceded from seven to nine and their defeats from two to three, so neither the standing headline nor the dek was still true.
